title: IBAN Format Definitions
description: Per-country IBAN format specifications including length, BBAN format patterns, bank identifier positions, and valid examples for validation

length.description: Total IBAN length including country code and check digits

bban_format.description: Regular expression pattern for the BBAN portion (after country code and check digits). Use: \d for digits, [A-Z] for uppercase letters, [A-Z0-9] for alphanumeric

example.description: A valid example IBAN that must pass Mod-97 check digit validation

bank_id_position.description: Position of the bank identifier within the BBAN (0-indexed)

start.description: Start index of bank identifier in BBAN

end.description: End index (exclusive) of bank identifier in BBAN

country_name.description: Optional: Full country name for documentation
